name: HC Maturity Model v1
description: Global 7-dimension HC maturity model - strategy, processes, people, data & technology, governance, culture, capability. Scored 1.0-5.0 with five bands.

bands.narrative: Reactive and ad-hoc - HC activities are unstructured, undocumented, and largely dependent on individuals.
Basic processes are forming, but adoption is uneven and outcomes are inconsistent.
Standardised processes and roles are in place; data is collected but not yet driving decisions.
Quantitatively managed - KPIs, governance, and feedback loops are embedded and reliable.
Continuously improving - HC is a strategic differentiator with predictive analytics and adaptive capabilities.
